title: Product Requirements Document
description: The single source of truth for PRD structure. hooks/validate-prd-frontmatter.sh is a thin caller of scripts/check-schema.py against this file. The validated object is built by check-schema.py: `frontmatter` is the parsed line-1 YAML block, `sections` maps each `## ` heading text to its ordinal.

frontmatter.description: Line-1 YAML frontmatter. Open to extra fields — see the same note in adr.schema.json.

id.description: Document ID (PRD-NNN). Assigned by /blueprint:sync-ids when missing.

status.description: Lifecycle state, capitalised to match ADR status casing.

title.description: Human title. Recommended: auto-sync-id-registry.sh falls back to the first `# ` heading when absent.

feature-codes.description: Hierarchical feature codes this PRD defines (FR1, FR1.1, ...)

then.title: No `title` in frontmatter — the manifest ID registry falls back to the first `# ` heading, which drifts when the heading is reworded.

sections.description: Map of `## ` heading text to its 0-based ordinal. PRDs declare no required sections; structure is governed by the PRD template, not this schema.
